summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any code or tests. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); clickable_ranges support in src/textual/renderables/underline_bar.py (one Text object, click spans last); style-preserving blend in src/textual/renderables/opacity.py; new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and tests/test_tabs.py; docs page docs/reference/tabs.md. Nothing was committed. Deviations to review: initial bar position uses the displayed index of the active name (differs from find_tab_by_name only with duplicates before the active name); letter search only applies to single-character keys; the layout resolver was left unchanged because its Edge protocol already declares size, min_size, and fraction; an empty label gets one cell because the resolver treats size 0 as unset; the sandbox demo was skipped as optional. Animation and on_key are not covered by tests.
